# prepare-ci-tests

[中文手册](../../../docs/zh/actions/prepare-ci-tests.md) · [English guide](../../../docs/en/actions/prepare-ci-tests.md)

在选定的测试环境安装项目所需的 Python 依赖，并选择一张符合条件、运行进程较少的 NPU 卡。

Installs project Python dependencies in the selected test environment and chooses an eligible NPU with fewer running processes.
